_comment: Data-driven abbreviation -> expansion map for curriculum-topic matching. Illustrative starter set only (the exact examples given in the normalization-audit spec) -- extend by editing this file, never by adding code branches. Keys are matched case-sensitively against the WHOLE trimmed term (never a substring), to avoid false positives like matching the word 'as'.
_scope_comment: Discipline keys (slugs of the discipline name recorded in the pipeline source manifest) this vocabulary applies to. The scoped loader (load_scoped_vocabulary) only applies it to topics from these disciplines, so e.g. 'CN' is never expanded to 'Computer Networks' inside a Chemical Engineering curriculum. Adding vocabulary for a new discipline = adding a new file under reference_data/vocab/, never code.
